month_notes: The winter schedule is in full effect from the 25th of last month: Singapore Airlines now runs a fourth daily flight from Changi, Sun PhuQuoc Airways has opened Shanghai, and VietJet’s Chiang Mai route is back after nearly three years. November is also the last full month before Long Thanh opens on 1 December — every international arrival into Ho Chi Minh City still clears Terminal 2.
empty_band_note: No international arrivals land in this window in November

context.text: Tan Son Nhat handled 39.9 million passengers in 2024 and is still Vietnam’s busiest airport. Every international arrival clears Terminal 2, which was built for 13 million passengers a year and now processes around 50,000 entry and exit movements a day — over 61,000 on its busiest. November is the last full month that the whole load sits on Terminal 2: Long Thanh opens on 1 December and takes long-haul services first, in phases running into 2027.
context.source: Airports Corporation of Vietnam, 2024; Thanh Nien, Feb 2026; ACV Long Thanh transition plan

basis: based on flight schedules and official airport data from 2024–2026
